statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) is ordered
The Holter monitor is ordered to evaluate for arrhythmias that may be contributing to these symptoms
The Holter monitor is ordered to assess the efficacy of current medical management
The denial reason code is CO-50
